Bar charts: EASY

Q1

No calculator

[2 marks]

A bar chart shows how students travel to college: bus 18, walk 12, car 7 and bike 5. How many more students come by bus than walk?

Hint

Answer

Take the two bars away.

Answer: 6

solve →

Q2

No calculator

[2 marks]

A bar chart shows the ice lollies sold in a week: Monday 15, Tuesday 20, Wednesday 25 and Thursday 10. (a) Which day sold the fewest? (b) How many lollies were sold on Monday and Tuesday together?

Hint

Answer

Fewest is the shortest bar.

Answer: (a) Thursday (b) 35

solve →

Q3

No calculator

[2 marks]

The scale on a bar chart goes up in 4s: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16. The top of a bar is half way between 8 and 12. What number does the bar show?

Hint

Answer

1

2

of the gap of 4.

Answer: 10

solve →

Answer

The bars only show the part above 40.

Answer: (a) 3 times (b)

7

5
